emojis.label: southern iran bears brunt of u.s. bombing
emojis.title: Southern Iran Bears Brunt of U.S. Bombing
emojis.summary: While fighting has abated in much of Iran, near-constant U.S. airstrikes in Qeshm island and other southern spots have upended lives and livelihoods.

emojis.label: transformed spanish hometown faces scrutiny
emojis.title: He Transformed His Spanish Hometown. Did He Also Spoil It?
emojis.summary: Francisco de la Torre, the mayor of Málaga, is credited with turning the once drab port into a culture and tech hub. Critics say he’s also destroyed the city’s soul.

emojis.label: trump limits childhood vaccines with new order
emojis.title: Trump signs order to limit childhood vaccines and split MMR shots
emojis.summary: The American Academy of Pediatrics calls the recommendation on measles, mumps and rubella shots "dangerous".

emojis.label: new train service connects finland and sweden
emojis.title: New train service connects Finland and Sweden for first time in decades
emojis.summary: The service will enable rail travel from Portugal to Lapland - what is believed to be the longest train journey in Europe.

emojis.label: powerful earthquake strikes colombia, many dead
emojis.title: Powerful 7.4 Earthquake Strikes Colombia, Killing More Than 100
emojis.summary: The quake shook major cities, including Bogotá, Cali and Medellín. At least 111 people have died, the president said, and the death toll appeared likely to rise as rescuers searched damaged buildings.
